name: dev.spacepost/mcp
title: SpacePost
description: Send email and manage domains, contacts and webhooks on SpacePost, the Resend-compatible email API.

environmentVariables.name: SPACEPOST_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: SpacePost API key (sp_live_...), created in the SpacePost dashboard under API keys. A sending_access key limits the server to sending.

environmentVariables.name: SPACEPOST_READ_ONLY
environmentVariables.description: Set to true to expose only read tools (GET endpoints).

environmentVariables.name: SPACEPOST_TOOLSETS
environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated API areas to expose, e.g. emails,domains.

environmentVariables.name: SPACEPOST_PERMISSION
environmentVariables.description: Set to sending_access to expose only the tools a sending_access key can call.

environmentVariables.name: SPACEPOST_DEFAULT_FROM
environmentVariables.description: Default sender, e.g. Acme <hello@acme.com>, used when a send omits from.
